divisions.headline: Element figures out the key to victory (the captain being gone?) in big win over Appetite; Jonesing sweeps DCkt to ease by Attack; Beach tops Wing, creates 3-way fight for 4th
Kids rip five doubles to hand Serious their first loss, take over B lead; Inconsistent digs out of singles hole in 1001 win over Possee; Angry Birds flap all over shorthanded Bottoms
Area uses DCkt sweep to stay undefeated, drop the Menace two back; Mafia downs a few Pints to move up to 2nd; Secrets and Ducks both win big, stay within reach of the #2 slot
Rally outlasts Sanchez to keep perfect record; Dart Knights survive nailbiter against the last place to keep pace; Bullies win, making D the only div. with a 2-win last place team
What's the Point sweeps doubles, open huge point lead when the 2nd place Blanks have both a narrow win and a penalty; Off Constantly takes down Corks for their first victory
oh, this division is just nuts… Death Throw loses, Down to F, Nein Mark, and She Said all win, and now the top 6 teams (of only 7) are separated by only 1 one match & 12 points
Banging takes out Rippin in 1001, taking the G lead alone just a week after Rippin's forfeit; Flight Club shuts down the Machine, now just a win and a handful of points out of 1st
Double Vision takes down Sofa in super tight battle of the H unbeatens; Afraid hands Bright Side their 3rd loss
